# asset-extension

assetExtension(filePath) must return exactly the POSIX path.extname result. Inputs are strings. Preserve the leading dot of a real extension and distinguish a leading-dot name, a final dot, and a multi-dot name. Directory components must not supply the extension.

Run: `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.

turns.prompt:
The asset-extension helper has a regression. First use web_fetch to open the official Node.js documentation at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/node/v22.14.0/doc/api/path.md and locate `path.extname(path)`. If the result is truncated, find this section in the full text file supplied by the tool. Read lib/asset-extension.cjs and tests/behavior.test.cjs, then fix the single exported function to meet this contract:
assetExtension(filePath) must return exactly the POSIX path.extname result. Inputs are strings. Preserve the leading dot of a real extension and distinguish a leading-dot name, a final dot, and a multi-dot name. Directory components must not supply the extension.
Change only the business module and preserve its public interface and all original tests. Use Node.js built-ins only, install nothing, make no network calls from code or tests, and write runtime artifacts only in the system temporary directory. Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs` and explain the documented rule, the fix, and the actual test result.

turns.final: Delegate to path.posix.extname: retain the dot, return empty for a dotfile, and retain a final standalone dot. Fixed lib/asset-extension.cjs; `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs` passes all original tests.
